state.task: We have a Flutter app for our hospital's patient-facing kiosk and mobile platform — it runs on wall-mounted Android tablets in waiting rooms, iPads carried by nurses, phones patients download it on, and a web version for desktop browsers. state.task: Our platform "FreightPulse" is a logistics orchestration system built on 14 Go microservices (order intake, route optimization, carrier matching, billing, notifications, etc.) communicating over gRPC and Kafka. We've been struggling with two related problems. First, when a shipment request fails somewhere in the chain — say carrier-matching times out or the billing service returns a partial error — we have almost no way to trace what happened end-to-end; logs from different services don't correlate and we're basically grepping timestamps manually. I need you to design and implement a full distributed tracing layer: generate correlation IDs at the API gateway, propagate them through gRPC metadata and Kafka headers, create parent/child spans for each service hop, and emit structured trace data compatible with OpenTelemetry. Include the Go middleware/interceptors, a Kafka producer/consumer wrapper that injects and extracts trace context, and a helper package for creating child spans with baggage propagation. Second, once we have that observability infrastructure specced out, I want to build an internal AI-powered incident investigation tool — when an on-call engineer pastes a correlation ID, it pulls the full trace tree and feeds it to an LLM to summarize what went wrong and suggest fixes. For that LLM integration, I need you to craft a precise, structured system prompt that instructs the model on how to analyze distributed trace data: it should understand span hierarchies, latency breakdowns, error codes from our specific services, Kafka consumer lag signals, and gRPC status codes, then produce a root-cause summary with confidence levels and recommended remediation steps. The prompt needs to handle ambiguous traces (partial data, missing spans) gracefully and ask clarifying questions when the trace is inconclusive. Give me both the tracing infrastructure code and the optimized system prompt with an explanation of the prompt design choices you made.
